listening.en: The stakes were high when the archive chose its new format, because a poor transfer could make years of recorded interviews difficult to use; the team tested copies before changing the originals.
listening.zh: 檔案庫選新格式時涉及重要得失，因轉存不佳可令多年訪談難以使用；團隊改原檔前先測複本。

options.en: A poor transfer could affect access to years of interviews.
options.zh: 轉存不佳可影響使用多年訪談。

options.en: Only one expendable test file was affected, with no consequence for the interview collection.
options.zh: 只有一個可棄測試檔受影響，對訪談收藏無後果。

options.en: The copies had already replaced and erased the originals before testing.
options.zh: 測前複本已取代並刪掉原檔。

options.en: No recordings depended on the choice of format.
options.zh: 沒有錄音受格式選擇影響。

listening.explanationZh: 多年訪談使用可受影響，是重要得失；測複本是為保護原檔，不表示只有無關緊要測試檔涉及。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼檔案格式的決定要慎重？
reply.promptEn: Why did the archive need to be careful about the format decision?

options.en: A poor transfer could make years of interviews harder to use.
options.zh: 轉存不佳可能令多年訪談較難使用。

options.en: The stakes were high because the choice affected access to the interview collection.
options.zh: 選擇影響使用訪談集，所以涉及重要得失。

options.en: The team had an important collection to preserve through the change.
options.zh: 團隊需在改動中保留重要收藏。

options.en: The consequences extended beyond one file to years of recorded material.
options.zh: 後果不只一檔，還涉及多年錄音材料。

reply.explanationZh: 四句有具體重要後果，不把慎重當必定出錯。

scene.promptZh: 學校選通報平台，若重要通知不能到達家庭，家長可能錯過接送改動；你想說明需試送確認。哪句合適？

options.en: The stakes are high because families depend on receiving the travel updates.
options.zh: 家庭依靠收到接送更新，所以涉及重要得失。

options.en: The decision is only about which decorative border people like.
options.zh: 決定只關乎喜歡哪種裝飾邊框。

options.en: The platform has already been selected for full use before the proposed test messages are sent.
options.zh: 提議試送訊息前，平台已被選定全面使用。

scene.explanationZh: 接送更新需到達家庭，故選平台前應試送核實；不是只選外觀，也不能把待測當已確認可全面用。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 the stakes are high 得出？

options.en: A decision may have important consequences.
options.zh: 決定可能有重要後果。

options.en: The correct option is already established without further evidence.
options.zh: 毋須更多證據，正確選項已確立。

options.en: Careful assessment may matter because of what could be affected.
options.zh: 因可能受影響事物重要，仔細評估可重要。

contrast.explanationZh: 重大程度不自行選出答案。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴問「後果重要，所以一定不能試任何新格式？」但團隊可用複本先試。哪句較準確？

options.en: The importance calls for a careful test with copies, not an automatic refusal to consider change.
options.zh: 重要性要求用複本仔細試，不是自動拒考慮改變。

options.en: We should refuse even a reversible test on copies and keep the current format unexamined.
options.zh: 應連可逆的複本測試也拒絕，不檢視目前格式。

options.en: The current format works, so we should adopt the new one without a separate trial.
options.zh: 目前格式可用，所以應不用另試就採新格式。

dialogue.explanationZh: 重要後果支持安全試複本來比較；不用拒絕任何試驗，也不能由舊格式可用推新格式毋須測。

speaking.en: The stakes are high, so we should test the change carefully before relying on it.
speaking.zh: 涉及重要得失，所以依賴改動前應仔細測試。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把重要後果連到查核。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學生展覽要把外借家庭照片印成大圖，若誤配人名或未問同意便公開，可能傷害借出者信任。你要向組員解釋為甚麼定稿前需核對署名及許可，不只看圖是否漂亮。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用身份及同意涉及信任的具體後果支持重要性，提出定稿核對，不只誇大形容或把後果重大當已知正確。

examples.en: The stakes are high because a wrong name or missing permission could damage the families’ trust. We should confirm the credits and consent before approving the prints.
examples.zh: 名字錯或欠許可可損家庭信任，所以涉及重要得失。批印前應確認署名及同意。

examples.en: The stakes are high when we display borrowed family photographs, so the final check must include names and permission, not just visual quality.
examples.zh: 展外借家庭照片涉及重要得失，所以最後核對需包括姓名許可，不只視覺品質。

takeaways.en: The stakes were high because the new instructions would guide visitors who had never used the route.
takeaways.zh: 新指引會帶領未走過路線的訪客，所以涉及重要得失。

takeaways.en: When the stakes are high, a clear record of what has been checked helps the team decide.
takeaways.zh: 涉及重要得失時，清楚記已核事項可幫團隊決定。

brief.meaningEn: Keep several different responsibilities or activities going at the same time.

brief.grammar: keep several plates spinning; kept in past; keeping in progress; explain which responsibilities compete for attention.

listening.promptZh: 意象描述哪種工作狀況？

options.en: Several ongoing responsibilities with some shared cover.
options.zh: 幾項持續責任，並有部分輪替支援。

options.en: A single completed task with no other demands.
options.zh: 一項已完成任務，沒有其他要求。

options.en: Arrivals, room questions and updates to the leaders.
options.zh: 抵達、房間提問及給領隊更新。

options.en: She was keeping several plates spinning across those different duties.
options.zh: 她在那些不同責任間同時兼顧多項。

options.en: Several parts of the day needed her attention, with cover for breaks.
options.zh: 當天幾個部分需她留意，小休有頂替。

options.en: She combined checking people in with answering and passing on information.
options.zh: 她把登記、答問題及傳資訊一併處理。

options.en: The current duties are already finished, leaving the whole week free for photography.
options.zh: 目前責任已做完，整周都空出可做攝影。

options.en: A classmate has already agreed to take over the proofreading, so the new role is confirmed.
options.zh: 同學已答應接校對，所以新角色已確認。

scene.explanationZh: 目前有多項持續責任，應先核重疊及可交接的人手；不能把原任務當完成或未問的幫手當已答應。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不宜只憑 keeping several plates spinning 得出？

options.en: Several activities need attention at the same time.
options.zh: 幾項活動同時需留意。

options.en: A named colleague has already agreed to take over the next additional duty.
options.zh: 某位具名同事已答應接手下一項新增責任。

options.en: The context may identify what can be shared with others.
options.zh: 情境可指出哪些可與別人分擔。

contrast.explanationZh: 兼顧多項只描述現有注意力需要，不確立下一項責任已有指定人接；仍需查實際分工。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴問「你兼顧得來，就再加兩項也沒問題吧？」但你還未查時間及分工。哪句最好？

options.en: Let’s review the current duties and available help before adding more.
options.zh: 加工作前，先檢視現有責任及可用幫助。

options.en: I will accept the two new tasks now and check the current timetable afterwards.
options.zh: 我會先接兩項新任務，之後才核目前時間表。

options.en: The colleague covering my breaks has already agreed to handle the new tasks too.
options.zh: 頂替我小休的同事已答應也處理新任務。

dialogue.explanationZh: 加前需檢視負荷及可用幫助；不能先承諾才核，也不能把小休支援擴成新任務已有人接。

speaking.en: I am keeping several plates spinning, so I want to check the priorities before taking on another task.
speaking.zh: 我同時兼顧多項，所以再接任務前想查優先。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把多責任與安排連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你和同伴為家庭聚會準備相簿、飯餐名單及遠方親友視像連結，三項都要跟進。你想在訊息說明目前多項兼顧，請同伴接手連結測試，自己核相片姓名，而非說不需幫忙。用一至兩句英文表達。
writing.selfCheckZh: 具體列三項並行準備，提出連線與姓名分工，不把多任務當完美無助完成或自己全做。

examples.en: We are keeping several plates spinning with the album, meal list and video link. Could you test the link while I check the names under the photographs?
examples.zh: 我們同時兼顧相簿、飯餐名單及視像連結。你可測連結，我核照片下姓名嗎？

examples.en: Keeping several plates spinning will be easier if we divide the next checks. I can handle the photograph names, and you could confirm the video connection.
examples.zh: 分開下一輪核對，會較易同時兼顧多項。我可處理照片姓名，你可確認視像連線。

takeaways.en: The coordinator kept several plates spinning by checking which tasks could be shared.
takeaways.zh: 協調員查哪些可分擔，讓多項責任同時維持。

takeaways.en: We were keeping several plates spinning, but one part still needed a clear owner.
takeaways.zh: 我們兼顧多項，但一部分仍需清楚負責人。

titleEn: burn the candle at both ends
titleZh: 早晚不停忙而耗盡精神

brief.meaningEn: Be active late at night and early in the morning, leaving too little rest and becoming very tired.
brief.meaningZh: 晚睡忙碌又早起，休息不足而十分疲憊。
brief.grammar: burn the candle at both ends; burning in progress; burned/burnt in past; show the late-and-early pattern.
brief.register: Established candle-life idiom. It describes exhausting routines, not a medical diagnosis or literal candles.
brief.boundaryZh: 只忙一次下午不足以支持；需早晚都忙與少休息線索，也不由它判品格或疾病。
brief.misconceptionZh: 努力可有價值，仍可帶疲憊；不把耗盡精神當認真與否的唯一衡量。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體作息描述負荷，並與一般忙碌分清。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.expression: burning the candle at both ends
sources.sentence: She was burning the candle at both ends before the launch.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 22, table 1, row 5; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: I was burning the candle at both ends before the performance, editing until midnight and arriving for rehearsal at six; by Friday I was too tired to check the small details properly.
listening.zh: 演出前我早晚忙，剪輯到午夜、六時到排練；周五已累得不能好好核小細節。

options.en: Late-night editing and early rehearsals left little rest and visible tiredness.
options.zh: 夜深剪輯加早排，少休息且明顯疲憊。

options.en: One busy afternoon followed by a normal night’s rest.
options.zh: 一個忙下午，之後正常休息。

options.en: A decision to move all work into one short daytime slot.
options.zh: 把所有工作移進一段短白日時段的決定。

options.en: A report about the brightness of the stage candles.
options.zh: 關於舞台蠟燭亮度的報告。

listening.explanationZh: midnight及six配too tired，說早晚負荷而非一段白天工作。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼到周五你難以仔細核對？
reply.promptEn: Why was careful checking difficult for you by Friday?

options.en: I had been editing late and returning very early for rehearsal.
options.zh: 我一直夜深剪輯，再很早回來排練。

options.en: I was burning the candle at both ends and had become very tired.
options.zh: 我早晚忙而少休息，已十分疲憊。

options.en: The midnight finishes and six-o’clock starts left too little rest.
options.zh: 午夜才完、六時開始，留太少休息。

options.en: That repeated late-and-early schedule had worn me down by Friday.
options.zh: 反覆夜深及清早忙的安排，到周五已令我很累。

reply.explanationZh: 四句用早晚時間與疲憊作理由，不加診斷。

scene.promptZh: 角色每天清晨開店，晚間又整理訂單到深夜，連日疲憊；你想形容這種早晚忙。哪句準確？

options.en: She is burning the candle at both ends.
options.zh: 她早晚不停忙，休息不足。

options.en: She worked only one afternoon and then had her usual rest.
options.zh: 她只忙一個下午，之後正常休息。

options.en: Her candle supply was running low while her workday stayed short.
options.zh: 她蠟燭快用完，而工作天仍短。

scene.explanationZh: 清晨開店深夜整單及累，合比喻；不是一次下午或實際燭。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項最不足以支持 burning the candle at both ends？

options.en: Repeated late nights and early starts with little rest.
options.zh: 反覆夜深及清早忙，少休息。

options.en: One busy daytime meeting followed by the usual rest.
options.zh: 一次忙白日會議，之後正常休息。

options.en: A schedule that keeps someone active at both ends of the day and leaves them exhausted.
options.zh: 早晚都忙而令人疲憊的時間表。

contrast.explanationZh: 一般白日忙不等於早晚兩頭耗力。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴說「你越累就越認真」，但你周五已漏核細節。哪句較準確？

options.en: The effort was real, but the exhaustion made the checking harder; tiredness is not the measure of care.
options.zh: 努力是真的，但疲憊令核對更難；疲憊不是認真的尺度。

options.en: The number of hours is enough to judge how carefully the details were checked.
options.zh: 工作時數已足以判斷細節核得多仔細。

options.en: We should assess the workload from the early rehearsals alone and leave the late editing out of the total.
options.zh: 應只按早排評工作量，不把夜深剪輯算入總量。

dialogue.explanationZh: 需承認早排與夜剪都佔負荷，再看疲憊令漏核的實際影響；不能以時數代準確或漏算晚間工作。

speaking.en: I was burning the candle at both ends, and the lack of rest was affecting how carefully I worked.
speaking.zh: 我早晚忙而少休息，已影響工作細緻程度。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再用實際作息與影響說明。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你連日清晨幫家中店鋪開門，夜裏又為交流活動做字幕到很晚，已覺疲憊。朋友邀你這周再排一次演出，你想禮貌婉拒這次，說可談下個月，不責怪邀請者。用一至兩句英文回覆。
writing.selfCheckZh: 以已給清早與深夜忙說明當下負荷，禮貌婉拒並提其他時間，不責怪邀請者或承諾這周仍全接。

examples.en: I am burning the candle at both ends with early shop openings and late subtitle work, so I cannot add another rehearsal this week. Could we discuss a date next month instead?
examples.zh: 我早上開店、夜裏做字幕，早晚都忙，所以這周不能再加排練。可否改談下月日期？

examples.en: Thank you for asking, but I have been burning the candle at both ends and am too tired for an extra performance now. I would be glad to look at next month with you.
examples.zh: 謝謝邀請，但我一直早晚忙，現在太累，不能加演。我樂意和你看下月安排。

takeaways.en: She had been burning the candle at both ends, preparing early and revising late into the night.
takeaways.zh: 她一直早晚忙，清早準備、夜深修改。

takeaways.en: We realised we were burning the candle at both ends when the early starts followed the late finishes.
takeaways.zh: 夜深才完又緊接清早開始時，我們發現自己早晚都忙。

brief.meaningEn: Make yourself very tired through the activity or effort you take on.
brief.meaningZh: 因自己投入的活動或工作，令自己十分疲憊。
brief.grammar: wear yourself out by + -ing; wore in past, have worn in perfect; the reflexive matches the person doing the activity.
brief.register: Standard wear-yourself-out exhaustion phrasal verb. It is distinct from patience or excuses wearing thin and from spreading attention across too many tasks.
brief.boundaryZh: 很累不必是永久狀態、疾病或工作沒價值；需描述實際工作量及感受，不由疲憊判能力。
brief.misconceptionZh: 可認真投入又需要分工，不能用是否累壞決定努力價值。
brief.outcomeZh: 能自然描述活動造成疲憊，正確用反身代名詞及詞形。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Managers can wear themselves thin without help.
sources.locatorNote: PDF page 22, table 1, row 6; source book/question/sample not stated where null.

listening.en: I wore myself out by setting up the display, carrying the boxes and answering messages without sharing the jobs; by the end I could barely concentrate on the final labels.
listening.zh: 我沒分工作，自己架展示、搬箱及答訊息，把自己累壞；到最後幾乎不能專注核標示。

options.en: Taking on the work alone left the speaker very tired and less able to concentrate.
options.zh: 獨自接工作，讓說話者很累、較難專注。

options.en: The display materials became physically thin through rubbing.
options.zh: 展示材料因磨擦而實際變薄。

options.en: The speaker’s excuses became less convincing to the group.
options.zh: 說話者藉口令小組越來越不信。

options.en: The jobs were shared evenly and the speaker felt rested at the end.
options.zh: 工作平均分擔，最後說話者精神恢復。

listening.explanationZh: 多項自己做及barely concentrate說人的疲憊，不是物料磨薄或藉口。

reply.promptZh: 為甚麼你最後難以專心核標示？
reply.promptEn: Why was concentrating on the labels difficult at the end?

options.en: I had taken on the setup, boxes and messages without sharing the work.
options.zh: 我沒有分擔，自己接架設、箱及訊息。

options.en: I wore myself out by trying to handle those jobs alone.
options.zh: 我嘗試自己處理那些工作，把自己累壞。

options.en: The combined effort had left me very tired by the final check.
options.zh: 多項工夫加起來，到最後核對已令我很累。

options.en: I had too little energy left after doing all those tasks myself.
options.zh: 自己做那些任務後，我餘下精神太少。

reply.explanationZh: 四句給累的活動來源，不拿品格或疾病作原因。

scene.promptZh: 人物整天自己搬書、整理分類，晚上很累，仍珍惜整理成果。哪句準確？

options.en: She wore herself out organising the books, even though she valued the result.
options.zh: 她整理書把自己累壞，儘管珍惜成果。

options.en: Her patience with an unconvincing excuse was wearing thin; no physical or mental fatigue is described.
options.zh: 她對不可信藉口耐性減，沒有描述身心疲憊。

options.en: She had shared the carrying work and ended the evening feeling rested.
options.zh: 她已分擔搬運，晚上結束時感到休息充足。

scene.explanationZh: 題目是自己整天搬整、晚上累而珍惜成果；不是耐性變薄，也不是已分工且精神充足。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句反身代名詞與主語不配合？

options.en: I wore myself out preparing the display.
options.zh: 我準備展示把自己累壞。

options.en: She wore themselves out preparing the display.
options.zh: 她準備展示把自己累壞。

options.en: They wore themselves out preparing the display.
options.zh: 他們準備展示把自己累壞。

contrast.explanationZh: she需herself；they可用themselves，I用myself。

dialogue.promptZh: 同伴問「你做完很累，所以那些工作沒有價值？」但你珍惜成果，只想分好工。哪句最好？

options.en: The work mattered to me, but sharing the jobs would leave more energy for the final check.
options.zh: 工作對我重要，但分擔會留更多精神作最後核對。

options.en: We should cancel the final label check as though it were only more of the exhausting setup.
options.zh: 應把最後標籤核對也當作更多費力布置而取消。

options.en: I will keep the same solo division of work next time without checking whether anyone can help.
options.zh: 下次我會不問是否有人可幫，維持同樣獨做分配。

dialogue.explanationZh: 可肯定有用工作並分擔體力布置，保留精神做仍必要的最後核對；不全取消核對或未問就繼續全獨做。

speaking.en: I do not want to wear myself out before the final check, so I will agree on a clearer division of work.
speaking.zh: 我不想最後核對前就把自己累壞，所以會議定較清楚分工。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽，再把疲憊及分工連起來。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為旅行畫速寫，原想每天完成六頁，試兩天後已累得沒精神留意景物。你仍想畫，但打算把目標改成每天一幅仔細觀察的作品，不以頁數當投入程度。用一至兩句英文寫反思及新目標。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用過多頁數及觀察力受影響說明疲憊，提出一幅仔細畫的新範圍，不把累當價值低或放棄所有創作。

examples.en: I wore myself out trying to finish six pages a day and stopped noticing the scenes carefully. I will aim for one thoughtful sketch instead.
examples.zh: 我嘗試每天六頁，把自己累壞，沒再仔細留意景物。我會改以一幅深思速寫為目標。

examples.en: I do not want to wear myself out chasing a page count. One carefully observed drawing each day would let me stay involved without rushing through the view.
examples.zh: 我不想追頁數把自己累壞。每天一幅仔細觀察的畫，可讓我投入，不匆匆看過景色。

takeaways.en: She wore herself out doing the preparation alone and asked the team to share the next round.
takeaways.zh: 她獨自準備把自己累壞，請團隊分擔下一輪。

takeaways.en: We had worn ourselves out before the final review, so the next plan included clearer handovers.
takeaways.zh: 最後檢視前我們已把自己累壞，所以下輪計劃加入較清楚交接。
